title: Generated application cron configuration
description: Runtime check for the cron object in config/default.json. This is not a generation option. Generation answers stay the four keys in wizard/answers.schema.json. cargo-generate exclude copies a file without Liquid rendering and does not omit it; that list is AGENTS.md.j2 and CLAUDE.md.j2. This schema is on [template] ignore, so a generated project does not contain it and does not contain answers.schema.json. The daemon reads cron.max_schedule_rows from config/default.json. Keys other than cron are outside this check. No layout opens the scheduler yet; the layout that does passes CronConfig::row_limit into sc_cron::ScheduleLimits.

max_schedule_rows.description: Maximum schedule rows, enabled and disabled. JSON null or 0 means unlimited. A missing key defaults to 10, the same value as CronConfig's serde default.
